dedupe_keys.name: bentley openrail designer rail and transit design bim software

description: OpenRail Designer is Bentley's building information modelling software for designing, modelling, analysing and documenting rail networks and transit systems in track and corridor projects. The product page says it includes tools for surveying, geotechnical analysis, drainage, underground utilities, detailed track design and low-voltage asset placement, unifies rail, track and structures in a model-centric environment as a single source of truth across disciplines, and automates documentation through intelligent 3D modelling. It is sold under licence, with offers bundling a licence and credits for training or services. Coverage: rail and transit projects worldwide. Format and access: licensed desktop software. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid. Caveats: a marketing page without file format or interoperability details. It supports digital twin and capacity planning work that starts from detailed rail design models. It relates to the Bentley iTwin platform and OpenPaths EMME in the catalogue.
